title: Ehrhart Theory of the Join of Two Lattice Polytopes
summary: Inspired by research on the Cartesian product of two lattice polytopes, this paper investigates the Ehrhart theory of the join of two lattice polytopes. This is also a well-known open problem listed on the website of the American Institute of Mathematics. This paper resolves this open problem. We first construct counterexamples showing that the join of two Ehrhart positive polytopes is not necessarily Ehrhart positive.
